message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The scenario: Wu (吴某) wants to get contract for construction of residential building for workers. He approaches officials (director, deputy director, party secretary) and they agree to give contract without public bidding in exchange for bribes (good money). Wu pays cash to officials. So Wu is a private individual giving bribes to state officials to obtain contract. This is bribery (受贿) but from the perspective of the bribe giver, the crime is "行贿" (giving bribe). In Chinese criminal law, giving bribes to state staff is "行贿罪". The examples: earlier similar case (金某) gave bribes to hospital director, answer: 行贿. So here answer: 行贿.

Thus final answer: [罪名]行贿<eoa>
